name: Pietra Ligure (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pietra Ligure (a red cross on white above a mountain on blue) in a yellow cartouche within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Pietra Ligure, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pietra Ligure arms — red cross on white above a mountain on blue, crowned, in a cartouche within branches
